title: Scenario cards: declare which scope fields hold a person handle, and drop only the turns a refused seed row actually feeds
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2ebbZkr2QAEG1x7UC8

Filing gate: ② follow-up from a contract review. Should-fixes S1 and S2 of the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review 6683045112 on PR #30903 (#30882). That PR lands without them because neither causes a false grade today. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.

**Business reason.** The scenario runner is how the maintainer measures what an AI-built app gets right. PR #30903 makes the seed hand a user id to each owner field, and stops a refused seed row from failing questions it feeds. Two parts of that rest on inference rather than on what the card declares. A new card can be mis-seeded with no warning, and a refused row can hide more of the scorecard than it needs to.

## S2: the handle fields are inferred, not declared

`userHandleFields` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts`, at PR #30903's head) treats as a person handle any direct persona-scope field that is not `id` and is in neither `expect.lookups` nor the select fields. That is right for all nine cards today: exactly `account.owner`, `invoice.owner` and `task.assignee`. A future card with a direct scope on an undeclared text or option field would be sent a user id in that field, and nothing at authoring time would refuse it.

**Wanted:**
- The card format declares the handle fields (for example a `user` kind on the scope rule, or a list on the card).
- The loader refuses a scope on a field that is neither declared a handle nor a known lookup or select.
- The run record lists the fields the seed rewrote.
- The loader is in flight in #30846 (#30802). Start after it lands.

## S1: dependence on a refused row is object-level

`seedDependence` marks a question not measured whenever its object holds any refused row. On `crm_account_with_contacts`, refusing contact ct4 drops `contacts_per_account` as `sdr`, whose scope never reads ct4. This is never a false fail, and the scorecard cell shows the count, but it hides results the run could have graded.

**Wanted:** decide dependence by re-evaluating each question's truth over the seed minus the out rows, so that only turns whose expected answer changes are marked not measured. Pin it with the ct4 case.

**Level:** QA tooling only, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Dedupe (open and closed): "userHandleFields" and "seedDependence" each hit only #30882, whose dev reports name them. **New.**

Related: #30882, PR #30903, #30913 (the sibling owner_id finding), #30802.

Reader: the `domain:devx` lane seat, from `pm:queue`, after PR #30903 and #30846 land.
